name: open-data
description: One question for each fixed open-data rule in dalil/opendata.py, asked through the real pipeline. Each must come back with the number in a kept sentence, a data citation on the rule's table and column, and the checker's rerun returning that value. The values are what the committed files in data/open/ hold, worked out before the run. Written 25 November 2026, before the first run. D6 and D7, the same lookups asked in Arabic, were added on 25 November 2026 after the integration branch began answering in Arabic, also before their first run.

scenarios.title: Emirates ID renewals, ICP
scenarios.question: How many Emirates ID cards does ICP renew in a year?
scenarios.expect: the answer states 5856085 Emirates ID card renewals (2025), cites dalil.open_icp_transactions, the checker's rerun returns the value, and the lookup ran on the local database

scenarios.title: Residence permit renewals, ICP
scenarios.question: How many residence permit renewals does ICP handle each year?
scenarios.expect: the answer states 3763072 residence permit renewals (2025), cites dalil.open_icp_transactions, the checker's rerun returns the value, and the lookup ran on the local database
